name: scylla-http
description: HTTP request execution and file-backed request artifacts for HikariSystem Scylla.

scylla.governor.scope.markdownDescription: In-scope host allowlist for ALL Scylla traffic (the engagement boundary). Supports exact hosts (`target.com`) and wildcards (`*.htb`). When EMPTY, Scylla does not restrict egress by settings (back-compat), but a running job still constrains traffic to its declared target. When non-empty, any request to a host NOT on this list is blocked. Keeping this accurate prevents out-of-scope hits (a bounty-scope violation) and stops scanners from wandering off-scope via redirects.

scylla.governor.enforceScope.markdownDescription: When `true` (default), the `#scylla.governor.scope#` allowlist is ENFORCED and out-of-scope requests are blocked. Set to `false` to make scope advisory (no blocking) without clearing your scope list.

scylla.governor.rateLimitPerSec.markdownDescription: Maximum requests per second PER HOST (token bucket). `0` = unlimited (default). Set this when testing a live target to avoid rate-limit bans or accidental denial of service.

scylla.governor.maxConcurrency.markdownDescription: Maximum number of in-flight HTTP requests across all Scylla scanners. `0` = unlimited (default). A small value (e.g. `8`) keeps aggressive multi-scanner runs polite.

scylla.governor.consent.markdownDescription: Authorization attestation that gates AUTOMATIC job runs. When `false` (default), dropping or opening a `.scylla_job.json` does NOT silently launch scanners -- you get a notification with a 'Run scan now' action instead. Set to `true` ONLY when you are authorized to test the targets in your job files and want auto-run on file create / change / startup.
